facts.fact: The Information Regulator, with a chairperson, a full-time member, two part-time members and a CEO, issued a notice on 16 September 2025 under the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013.
The Information Regulator's gazette notice of 26 September 2025 acts under the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 and its section 112(2)(c).
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

facts.fact: The Information Regulator, chaired by Adv. FDP Tlakula, issued the notice inviting comments on draft regulations under the Act.
The Information Regulator published draft regulations on health or sex life data under POPIA on its website and invited written comments by 10 October 2025.
The Information Regulator invited public comments, due 10 October 2025, on draft regulations under the Protection of Personal Information Act.
